AccessControlPage.title: Access Control
AccessControlPage.description: Physical access control: doors and credentials.

records.title: Door and credential records work
records.body: FreeSDN can keep door and credential records: create, edit and remove them, with PINs stored only as one-way hashes. This page has no screens for them yet.
records.where: They are managed through the API under

doorControl.title: Physical door control is not available
doorControl.body: Locking or unlocking a door is refused (the API answers 501) until a real door-controller adapter is added, and none exists yet. FreeSDN cannot open or lock a door.

module.title: Ships disabled
module.body: The Access Control module ships disabled and is a preview: it cannot be turned on for an organization until a door-controller adapter exists. It is graded Experimental: built, but not proven against real door hardware.
